name: ai-analyzer-service
description: Node.js service that proxies UI regression analysis requests to an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint (defaults to OpenRouter + qwen/qwen3.6-plus). Validates incoming requests against the JSON Schema generated from Pydantic contracts in test_ui/contracts/.

scripts.test: node --check server.js && node --check scripts/validate.js && echo 'syntax OK (Vitest contract tests deferred - see plan A.4)'
